Content following a table whose last row is never closed is still converted

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using HtmlToMarkdown;

var result = HtmlToMarkdownConverter.Convert("<table><tr><th>Before</th></tr><tr></table><p>Visible footer</p>", new ConversionOptions());
Console.WriteLine(result.Content);
```
